notes: Built from the published Brave Web Search API reference (GET /res/v1/web/search, X-Subscription-Token header). The request fixture is the gateway native document, which lowers to bounded query parameters (q, count, offset, freshness, result_filter=web, text_decorations=false) with no JSON body. The response and the 422 error are schema-built. These are offline contract fixtures, not live-provider qualification.
